overview.description: A single bundle that lets students combine up to five popular programs: Spoken English, IELTS, PTE, Japanese (JLPT N5), and Chinese (HSK 1). Mix and match to fit your goals—college communication, test prep, or new languages.
features: Choose 1–5 tracks; start with a free placement/demo
Printed handouts and homework drills where applicable
Mock tests with evaluation for test‑prep tracks
Certificate(s) upon completion of each track
Advisor support to plan your sequence and schedule
overview.audienceText: Learners who want flexibility: improve English speaking, prepare for IELTS/PTE, or begin Japanese/Chinese—at their own pace.

curriculum.title: Confidence & Fluency (College/Work)
curriculum.intro: Speaking labs, role‑plays, pronunciation, targeted grammar & writing.
curriculum.summary: Practical speaking for campus and daily life.

curriculum.title: Listening · Reading · Writing · Speaking
curriculum.intro: Regular (3 mo) or Crash (1.5 mo); mocks with instant feedback.

curriculum.title: Computer‑based Integrated Skills
curriculum.intro: Speaking, Writing, Reading, Listening with analytics and templates.

curriculum.title: Hiragana · Katakana · Basic Kanji & Grammar
curriculum.intro: Daily conversation and N5‑style prep with two mock tests.
curriculum.summary: Solid beginner foundation for JLPT N5.

curriculum.title: Pinyin · Tones · Core Grammar & Vocabulary
curriculum.intro: Everyday dialogues, ~150 words, reading basics, two mock tests.

faqs.question: Can I take multiple tracks at once?
faqs.answer: Yes—subject to batch availability. Advisors help schedule without clashes.

faqs.question: Is there a demo or placement?
faqs.answer: Yes—FREE demo/placement for each track to set your level and plan.

faqs.question: Do I get materials?
faqs.answer: Printed handouts and practice sheets for language tracks; full prep packets for IELTS/PTE.

faqs.question: Are mocks included?
faqs.answer: Yes—in test‑prep tracks. Language tracks include progress checks and a final showcase.

cta.heading: Bundle and save — pick your 5‑in‑1 tracks today.
